name: @keepr/realtime
description: Realtime for every app: the Durable Object that fans a scope's channels out to its sockets, its wire protocol, the client transport that reconnects to it (ADR-0137), and the Nuxt layer an app extends to have them (ADR-0138).

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && pnpm types:object --check && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.object.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/object/tsconfig.json && pnpm typecheck:nuxt
scripts.typecheck:nuxt: nuxt prepare nuxt && tsc --noEmit -p nuxt/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p nuxt/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p nuxt/test/tsconfig.json
